classical_or_imported_inputs.classical: Programme contraction, fidelity bounds, binomial monotone likelihood ratio, local packing, Stieltjes integration, rational stereographic charts.
classical_or_imported_inputs.direct_antecedents: Fiurasek--Micuda PRA80(2009)042312; Sedlak--Ziman PRA90(2014)052312; Puchala et al PRA98(2018)042103 and Quantum5(2021)425. Models and imported roles distinguished in active comparison.
classical_or_imported_inputs.learning_methods: Bernstein concentration, product fidelity, adaptive conditional union bounds, and phase-estimation antecedents HB76/KLY76. The corrected small-cone argument is proved in full.
classical_or_imported_inputs.matrix_methods: Horizontal Kraus gauges, channel-extension metrology and finite-distance path integration are credited to FI76, DKG67, DM76, KGAD76, YF76 and SD76; inverse-Sylvester and spectral-volume antecedents to Dittmann76 and SZGeom76.
classical_or_imported_inputs.v73: Same-visibility angular modulus and finite Bernoulli majority lemma retained with complete proofs.

evidence_boundary: Finite exact tests check examples, arithmetic, legality and target replay. Written proofs and imported mathematics are not certified by finite regression or CI.

earlier.v71: Fixed-readout input-dependent law, row codec and full-error half-dimensional lower theorem.

v72.direct_flag_codec: Pivoted LU of unnormalized rational projector columns, exact phase-free rational decoding, explicit perturbation bound and finite bit-count.
v72.observable_readout: Written mixed-scale covering proof with arbitrary legal memoryless centres, fixed dimensions, retained or orthogonally recoverable readout and delta<=1/32.
v72.pauli_covering: Standard Pauli/Bell seizing yields rank/support-aware reusable-description law; mechanism is credited.
v72.uniform_seizable_covering: Exact metric and family-covering transfer with fixed processor and ambient-domain one-use left inverse; full submaximal-error rank-state corollary.

v73.conditional_states: Additive preparation rank dimension V yields log(1+K/delta)+(V/2)logN+Vlog(1/delta)+O(1), fixed ranks/dimension and small error, uniform visibility.
v73.finite_adaptive_modulus: Complete finite-distance upper and GHZ-block lower proof with absolute constants uniform in N, public lambda, and angle.
v73.noise_sequence_exponents: Continuous horizon coefficient (1+min(alpha,1))/2 when 1-lambda_N^2=N^-alpha+o(1) approaches zero; weak-visibility exponent max(1/2-beta,0).
v73.noise_uniform_covering: C_all and rational-circle C are comparable to 1+K/delta for 0<delta<=2^-10, K=lambda*sqrt(N*min(N,1/(1-lambda^2))); erased endpoint singleton.
v73.rational_codec: Exact rational circle factors, integer precision decision, CP/TP Choi assembly, conditional rank nonincrease and canonical target replay.

v74.contact: Written boundary-depth trichotomy, including critical logarithmic enhancement.
v74.joint_metric: Written finite-use proof for the entire unbiased binary qubit ball, including unequal visibilities and endpoints.
v74.joint_rational_code: Implemented and proved rational disk/ball code for Cartesian rational input, including irrational norm. Both visibility and direction are charged.
v74.weighted_covering: Written Ahlfors-regular local weighted-volume criterion with arbitrary legal lower centres.

v75.full_body_covering: Small-error cover of the full ordered binary qubit effect body has order N^2 log(N+2) delta^-4; lower permits all legal memoryless binary centres.
v75.full_ordered_binary_qubit_metric: Finite-use comparison for all legal biased effects with spectral endpoint cutoffs and cancellation-free angular recovery.
v75.rational_charged_code: Exact rational spectral and stereographic encoder charges both eigenvalues and direction in one payload; all scalar and support boundaries included.
v75.scalar_overlap_angular_bound: Explicit measurement-dilation gauge gives a scalar cross-overlap and a finite-N adaptive fidelity bound at every spectrum.

new_claims.all_rank_spectral_noncancellation: Every ordered eigenvalue has a Bernoulli lower witness; aligned spectra admit a d-row programme upper bound.
new_claims.common_qubit_learning: Written single common learner for all unknown biased qubit effects, risk eta in future-N adaptive loss delta, worst-case training Theta(N delta^-2 log(1/eta)); every entangled block at most N calls. Independent endpoint observations, unknown-noise block selection, and scalar KL lower bound.
new_claims.exact_matrix_certificate: Implemented Gaussian-rational legality, Sylvester solve, squared theorem bounds and complete supplied-pair replay. It evaluates the proved modulus, not the exact adaptive optimum.
new_claims.learned_rational_payload: Written rational rounding and existing exact qubit codec turn the learned estimate into the optimal-order reusable payload, without further device calls.
new_claims.matrix_entropy: Written full fixed-d small-error covering law N^(d^2/2) log(N+2)^floor(d/2) delta^(-d^2), with rational legal centres attaining the same order. Balanced prefixes and separated endpoint pairs prove the logarithmic multiplicity.
new_claims.matrix_metric: Written finite-N midpoint Sylvester comparison on every ordered binary effect body E_d, d,N>=1; all ranks and multiplicities. Lower min(1,Q)/(8192d), adaptive upper min(2,8Q).
new_claims.operational_ball_volume: Written uniform measure bounds c_d r^(d^2) <= mu_N(B(E,r)) <= C_d r^(d^2), including every singular boundary, using a full legal inward-shifted ellipsoid.
new_claims.uniform_adaptivity_comparison: Written d_N <= 65536 d d_N^na for each fixed dimension, uniformly in horizon; not equality of optima.
